text:
morgan: Heads-up — DAST run against staging flagged an open redirect on /auth/callback and SAST shows a related URI handling issue. I can't trivially map SAST finding id S-4512 to the running pod logs. Anyone with correlating telemetry or who owns request-id tracing?

sam: looping in @ana for tracing. do we have request-id injected in the nginx ingress or just app logs?

ana: we do X-Request-Id at ingress but it's sampled at 0.1 for prod; staging should be 1.0 but I think sampling config got reverted last week. checking.

morgan: scan-bot attached DAST report: https://redwood-internal/reports/312987 — payload + vulnerable redirect example included. SAST id S-4512 shows unvalidated redirect in oauth.go: line 78.

scan-bot: DAST scan complete — 1 high, 3 medium, 5 low. High: Open redirect /auth/callback. Evidence attached.

jess: re: RBAC/KMS: if we need to pull archived logs from blob store to correlate, will need kms:decrypt role for oncall. Who can approve short-lived grant?

evan: I can approve a 1-hour ephemeral KMS decrypt for @ana if SOC signs off. Please open ticket in infra-approvals with justification.

ana: confirmed sampling was 0.1. I set it back to 1.0 on staging: kubectl patch cm ingress-config -n infra -p '{"data":{"request_sampling":"1.0"}}' — logs should show full request-ids in ~2m.

morgan: started a vuln ticket: https://jira/redwood/SEC-9123. Please post correlating logs, SAST stack trace, DAST payloads. Assigning to @ana and @jess.

jess: noted. Also propose adding an automated correlation test to CI: after SAST or DAST flags oauth redirects, run a tiny harness to confirm redirect normalization. Example command to run locally:
```
./scripts/run_redirect_check.sh --target https://staging.red/ auth/callback --expect-host allowlist
```

evan: for audit logging: we need to ensure both the inbound request-id and the redirect param are captured in audit log schema. Filing follow-up with compliance.

morgan: plan: 1) @ana get logs + enable sampling 2) @jess request ephemeral KMS via infra-approvals 3) @sam add CI correlation test PR 4) @evan update audit schema. ETA EOD. If evidence shows exploitability, we hotfix redirect handling.

sam: I'll draft PR for CI test and a quick helper to parse SAST ids -> file: ./tools/sast_to_endpoint.py

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for fix branch 'fix/open-redirect-SEC-9123' — estimated start 1h after PR merge.

morgan: thanks — please ping here when logs attached. :pray:
